company_info.meta_description: Jinjiang Wideway (WIDEWAY GROUP) is a leading footwear manufacturer based in Jinjiang, Fujian since 2007. Specializing in athletic sneakers, casual footwear, 1:1 archival silhouette re-engineering, and private label OEM/ODM for global brands.
company_info.slogan_sub: A Masterpiece of Craftsmanship, Presenting Superior Quality

sales_team.name: WIDEWAY Export Desk
sales_team.specialty: OEM/ODM Tooling, Low MOQ, Tech Packs & Rapid Quotations

sport-outdoor-shoes.title: Sport & Outdoor Shoes Wholesale Manufacturer | WIDEWAY Jinjiang
sport-outdoor-shoes.desc: Source professional athletic footwear, trail running shoes, and outdoor sneakers directly from Jinjiang Wideway factory. High-elastic cushioning, breathable mesh, and low MOQ OEM/ODM.

casual-shoes.title: OEM Casual Shoes Factory & Sourcing | WIDEWAY GROUP
casual-shoes.desc: Custom private label casual shoes and lifestyle sneakers crafted with premium microfibers, lightweight EVA outsoles, and ergonomic fits for international fashion brands.

mens-shoes.title: Men's Sneakers & Streetwear Footwear Wholesale | WIDEWAY
mens-shoes.desc: Wholesale men's athletic sneakers, chunky runners, and modern streetwear shoes manufactured with strict quality control. Trusted by global retail chains and boutique labels.
mens-shoes.h1: Men's Athletic & Casual Footwear Bulk Supplier

womens-shoes.title: Women's Fashion Sneakers & Lightweight Shoes Factory | WIDEWAY
womens-shoes.desc: Ergonomically designed women's walking shoes, tennis trainers, and fashion sneakers. Breathable flying woven uppers, ultra-light sole cushioning, and trendy colorways.

slides-sandals.title: Custom Slides, Sandals & Slippers Factory | WIDEWAY GROUP
slides-sandals.desc: One-piece molded EVA slides, beach sandals, and recovery slippers. Non-slip outsoles, quick-drying comfort, and custom embossed logo branding.

bags-sportswear.title: Sportswear Backpacks & Athletic Bags Wholesale | WIDEWAY
bags-sportswear.desc: Durable water-resistant sports backpacks, gym duffels, and lifestyle accessories designed to complete your athletic brand lineup.
